meta.title: An astronomically large quantity is refused or fails cleanly
gaps: No setup recipe creates two QA drafts, one with line items and one without.
No operation or library case supports pulling a QA PR line into a draft with quantity 1e400.
The required product and product-quality identifiers are not available as tokens for a custom request.
The expected 422 codes 557 and 15, including the database message, cannot be asserted without a supported request and response fields.
